notes.title: Demo Update (Version 1.3.0)🎣
notes.notes: [p]We have now released [b]Version 1.3.0 of the Scale the Depths Demo,[/b] featuring [b]new control schemes for the hook[/b] when diving in the depths. These include [b]Mouse and Inverted Controls[/b], both of which can be changed in the Settings. Classic controls are still available as well. 🎮[/p][p][/p][p]Also, a big [b]thank you to everyone who has played the demo so far[/b]. We were floored by the amount of support we have received and how many of you expressed how much you liked the game. We also greatly appreciated the feedback on the demo, helping us make the appropriate tweaks to create a game everyone can enjoy. You all motivate us to keep pushing forward to make the full release something truly special. [b]We hope you continue to enjoy the demo, and happy fishing[/b]. 🐡 🙌[/p][p][/p][h1]Change Log[/h1][p][/p][h3]🐠  [b]QOL Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]*NEW*[/b] Mouse Hook Controls - Change in settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]*NEW[/b]* Inverted Hook Controls - Change in settings[/p][/*][/list][h3]🪼 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed ambient sound issues in the prep area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed soft locking problems with customers[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🦦 [b]UI &[/b] [b]Sound Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reduced knife swooping sound frequency [/p][/*][*][p]Lowered shop bell jingle SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Visual Updates[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Scale the Depths Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]We’re excited to announce that we’ve released a brand new demo for the full release of Scale the Depths![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OOywPGm2zCw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This is our first major update since its humble beginnings as a game jam demo for GMTK last year. We rebuilt the game from the ground up with plans to upgrade it to a full-scale release.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added some brand new gameplay elements, adjusted the game’s balance, and upgraded the game’s visuals to look reel-y nice![/p][p]
We have plans to add additional levels featuring brand-new locales, new gameplay mechanics, and of course, a lot more fish as we continue development. You can try out the game’s new demo for free [b]right now![/b]
[/p][p][b]Thank you for your patience, and we hope you enjoy the demo![/b][/p]
